name: CDIF Access
abstract: Profile module for machine-actionable access and usage conditions expressed as ODRL Offer policies. Requires that the metadata record declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/access/1.1 and carry at least one policy: inline or by {@id} reference as odrl:hasPolicy on a schema:distribution item, or as an {@id} reference in schema:conditionsOfAccess on the Dataset (only a reference there, because cdifCore's item shapes do not admit an inline Offer). Draft: the conformance URI and the cdifa1 action vocabulary are not yet minted. Uses building blocks: odrlOffer (odrlProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
